description: Text transform on cells in column CountyName using expression value.trim()

expression:
jython:import re

 # Standardize the spelling and formatting of hospital types
 value = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9 ]+', '', value).title()

 # Extract city information if available (assuming it is the last word in the value)
 match = re.search(r'\b\w+\b$', value)
 if match:
   city = match.group(0)
 else:
   city = None

 # Update the value to include city information if available
 if city:
   value += ', ' + city

 return value
return value
